desc:
A Drupal website redesign gives your existing site a fresh, faster look without moving your content or changing page addresses. Ecom Swift LLC reviews your site, agrees a direction with you, and builds the new design on a staging site for your approval.

## What is a Drupal website redesign?

A Drupal website redesign changes how your site looks and feels while keeping what it contains. The theme, layout, navigation, colors, fonts and page templates are rebuilt, but your articles, pages, media and addresses stay where they are. It is different from a migration, which moves content, and from a rebuild, which starts over.

Because Drupal separates content from presentation, a redesign can be done carefully on a staging copy while your live site stays untouched.

## Why keeping content and addresses in place matters

Your content and its addresses hold value that a design cannot replace. Other sites link to your pages, visitors bookmark them and search engines have already indexed them. If a redesign changes those addresses or loses articles, you pay twice: once for the design and again to repair the damage.

A redesign that preserves structure lets you refresh the look with little risk to existing visibility. Editors also keep working in forms they already know, so they do not need to relearn anything.

## How a redesign affects results

A new design helps in specific ways. Clearer navigation helps visitors find pages in fewer clicks. A better mobile layout makes the site usable on phones, where many visitors arrive. Consistent buttons and headings show people what to do next. Lighter images and cleaner templates make pages load faster, and speed affects both visitors and search engines.

A design also changes how credible you look. An outdated layout can make a good organization seem inactive, while a calm, consistent one signals care. We cannot promise a specific rise in traffic or enquiries, because those depend on content, audience and competition.

## What a good Drupal redesign includes

- A review of your current site, its page types and the problems visitors face.
- An agreed design direction: colors, typography, spacing and button style.
- A redesigned home page that states clearly what you offer.
- Redesigned page types for articles, landing pages, events or profiles, as needed.
- A new main menu and a mobile menu that is easy to use with one hand.
- Reusable cards and banner blocks, so editors can build pages without a developer.
- Listing and search result layouts that make long lists scannable.
- Restyled forms and buttons, consistent across the site.
- Images sized and compressed for faster loading.
- An accessibility pass on key pages, covering contrast, headings and keyboard use.

## What we do

We start by studying your current site and your goals, then propose a direction for you to approve. We then build or update the theme on a staging site, applying the new look to the home page, then to each agreed page type and the navigation. You review a private preview and request changes.

The Basic package refreshes the home page and the sitewide style. Standard adds several page types, a new menu and reusable blocks. Premium covers a full redesign with listings, forms and an accessibility pass. After approval we launch the new theme and check that links, forms and images still work.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Collect examples of sites you like and say why.
- Provide your logo, brand colors and best photos.
- Name the pages that matter most to your business.
- Review the preview on your own phone.
- Let editors try the new layouts before launch.

**Avoid:**
- Altering URLs only because the look of the site was updated.
- Filling the home page with banners and moving parts.
- Choosing fonts and colors with low contrast because they look elegant.
- Redesigning every page type when only a few get traffic.
- Launching without checking forms, menus and images.

## Who this is for

This suits an organization whose Drupal site works well but looks dated. It suits a team that wants a modern layout without the cost and risk of rebuilding, and a site owner whose pages are hard to read on phones.

## What we need from you

Send your site address, your brand materials and a short note on what you like and dislike about the current look. You add us as a developer user on the site, and we never need a password. A staging copy helps, and if you do not have one we can create it. We confirm the direction with you before we build.
